title: Amazing Amber French Flaxseed Galette
description: A resinous and glassy-jelly French dish featuring flaxseed, perfect for a quick-fix dessert or snack, this galette is dairy-free-friendly and made in a classic French style, originating from the Burgundy region.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the ground flaxseed, almond milk, maple syrup, and coconut oil.
Add the vanilla extract and salt, and whisk until well combined.
Pour the mixture into a 9-inch tart pan with a removable bottom.
Bake for 25 minutes, or until the edges are lightly golden.
While the galette is baking, combine the pomegranate juice and agar agar powder in a small saucepan.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 5 minutes, or until the mixture has thickened.
Remove the galette from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes.
Pour the pomegranate juice mixture over the galette and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.
Serve the galette chilled, garnished with fresh fruit or nuts if desired.
